# CareerOS — https://careeros.ai
> Assisted Career Operating System for India manufacturing (Purchase, procurement, SCM). Pan-India. Human Confirm apply. Never silent LinkedIn/Naukri Easy Apply.

## Product
CareerOS is a daily hunt OS: set targets → resume + ATS-style readiness → up to 3 graded searches/day and 15 Confirm-apply seats → tailored packet → candidate submits on the employer site → track pipeline.

Audience: India manufacturing hunters (Purchase Manager, Buyer, Sourcing, SCM) in Pune, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, NCR, Jamshedpur and other industrial cities. Preferred cities rank, they do not hide other India locations.

Sources: OEM Workday + Greenhouse/careers first. Paste Naukri/LinkedIn JDs. Not a whole-web scrape bot.

## Pricing (INR)
- Starter: free (builder + scorecard)
- Concierge: ₹1,999/mo (founder-reviewed pack; candidate still Confirm applies)
- Pro: ₹999/mo target when inventory is consistently buy-worthy

14-day Concierge pilot: fewer than 5 India-fit seats or 0 packets after Profile + Resume → refund/extend.
